adjudication.rationale: The diff updates the Calendar interface so `createEvent(event, credentialId)` is called from `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts` (`calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`), and GoogleCalendarService uses that `credentialId` to select the matching destination calendar. However, `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` still defines `async createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` and selects the calendar via `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`, i.e., always using the first destination calendar. With `destinationCalendar` now an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` potentially creating multiple events for multiple destination calendars, LarkCalendarService will not select the destination calendar corresponding to the credential being used, causing events to be created/updated/deleted against the wrong calendar when multiple destination calendars are present.
